about.description:
The XROOTD project aims at giving high performance, scalable fault tolerant
access to data repositories of many kinds. The typical usage is to give
access to file-based ones. It is based on a scalable architecture, a
communication protocol, and a set of plugins and tools based on those. The
freedom to configure it and to make it scale (for size and performance)
allows the deployment of data access clusters of virtually any size, which
can include sophisticated features, like authentication/authorization,
integrations with other systems, WAN data distribution, etc.
about.summary: Metapackage installing all XRootD components (libraries, headers, CLI tools, Python bindings)

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: xrootd
  version: "6.1.1"

recipe:
  name: xrootd-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/xrootd/xrootd/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 218759d5fa0a7bf8b78cb465a75ed40b7b7f3d49fbf71697bb42a7597a869586
  patches:
    - patches/0001-Fix-cross-compilation-CMP0190.patch

build:
  number: 0
  skip: win

outputs:
  # Build the C++ core once per job with the Python bindings disabled. The
  # bindings are built separately (see the "python-xrootd" output below)
  # against the installed libraries, which avoids find_package(Python) running
  # in the cross-compiled main build (CMake >= 4.1, policy CMP0190).
  - staging:
      name: xrootd-build
    build:
      script:
        file: build_core.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - make
        - pkg-config
      host:
        - openssl
        - readline
        - libxml2-devel
        - if: not osx
          then: libuuid
        - libcurl
        - krb5
        - zlib
        - ncurses
        - scitokens-cpp
        - libxcrypt

  - package:
      name: libxrootd
    inherit: xrootd-build
    build:
      files:
        # versioned shared libraries (linux / macOS)
        - lib/libXrd*.so.*
        - lib/libXrd*.*.dylib
        # runtime-loaded plugins (named libXrd<Name>-<major>.so on both platforms)
        - lib/libXrd*-*.so
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libxrootd', upper_bound='x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          lib:
            - XrdCl
            - Xrd*
          files:
            # runtime-loaded plugins use a .so suffix on both Linux and macOS
            - lib/libXrd*-*.so
    about:
      summary: XRootD shared libraries and plugins

  - package:
      name: libxrootd-devel
    inherit:
      from: xrootd-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        include:
          - include/xrootd/**
          - lib/cmake/**
          - bin/xrootd-config
          # unversioned development symlinks
          - lib/libXrd*.so
          - lib/libXrd*.dylib
        exclude:
          # plugins and versioned libraries belong to libxrootd
          - lib/libXrd*-*.so
          - lib/libXrd*.*.dylib
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libxrootd', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libxrootd', upper_bound='x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          include:
            - xrootd/XrdVersion.hh
            - xrootd/**
          bin:
            - xrootd-config
          lib:
            - XrdCl
            - Xrd*
          files:
            exists:
              - lib/cmake/XRootD/XRootDConfig.cmake
              - lib/cmake/XRootD/*.cmake
            not_exists:
              - lib/libXrd*-*.so
              - lib/libXrd*.so.*
              - lib/libXrd*.*.dylib
    about:
      summary: Development files (headers, CMake config) for XRootD

  - package:
      name: xrootd-cli
    inherit: xrootd-build
    build:
      files:
        include:
          - bin/**
          - share/**
        exclude:
          - bin/xrootd-config
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libxrootd', upper_bound='x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - xrdcp --version
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          bin:
            exists:
              - xrootd
              - cmsd
              - xrdcp
              - xrdfs
              - "*"
            not_exists:
              - xrootd-config
          files:
            - share/man/man*/*
            - share/xrootd/utils/*
    about:
      summary: XRootD command line tools and server binaries

  - package:
      name: python-xrootd
    inherit: xrootd-build
    build:
      script:
        file: install_python.sh
      files:
        - lib/python*/site-packages/**
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - setuptools
            - pip
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - make
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        - setuptools
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libxrootd-devel', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libxrootd', upper_bound='x') }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libxrootd', upper_bound='x') }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - XRootD.client
            - pyxrootd
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          site_packages:
            - XRootD.client
            - pyxrootd
          files:
            - lib/python*/site-packages/XRootD/**
            - lib/python*/site-packages/pyxrootd/**
            - lib/python*/site-packages/xrootd-*.dist-info/**
    about:
      summary: Python bindings for XRootD

  # Metapackage matching the old monolithic "xrootd" package
  - package:
      name: xrootd
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libxrootd', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libxrootd-devel', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('xrootd-cli', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('python-xrootd', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libxrootd', upper_bound='x') }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - XRootD.client
            - pyxrootd
      - script:
          - xrdcp --version
          - test -f "${PREFIX}/include/xrootd/XrdVersion.hh"
    about:
      summary: Metapackage installing all XRootD components (libraries, headers, CLI tools, Python bindings)

    The XROOTD project aims at giving high performance, scalable fault tolerant
